pre_reflection.text:
[Pre-reflection] The strategy's main weaknesses include potential look-ahead bias from using RSI and ADX lagging indicators, over-reliance on single crossover signals that may generate whipsaws, and lack of position sizing or profit targets. The tight ADX filter (25) might miss profitable trending periods, while the bollinger band width could be too static for varying volatilities. Entry and exit rules are too rigid without considering momentum confirmation or volatility-adjusted stops.
[Backup plan] If results are poor, I'd test a modified entry: close crosses above bollinger.lower AND rsi < 30 AND adx > 20 AND price > sma(20) to filter false signals. If Sharpe is mediocre, I'd increase bollinger period to 20, widen RSI threshold to 25-35, and add trailing stops. Alternative: switch to a volatility-based mean reversion using ATR bands with a 10-period RSI filter, or try a momentum filter with MACD histogram for trend confirmation.
